entities.name: IntegrationsDomain
observations: [2026-06-08] Existing surface at /(app)/integrations/page.tsx + /api/integrations/{route.ts,[id]/sync/route.ts} predates Sprint 6 — originally built for ICS calendar URLs and GitHub public-events polling (no auth required for either). The schema comment on IntegrationConnection already predicted OAuth providers would land in this same row via an encrypted token blob inside config.

[2026-06-08] Sprint 6A extended the system with Notion OAuth without a schema migration. The IntegrationConnection model's config: Json slot is the extension point — encrypted tokens live under config.tokenRef = { version: 'v1', accessToken: <ciphertext>, refreshToken: null, expiresAt: null, scope: null }. New OAuth providers (OneDrive in 6C, etc.) reuse this exact shape.

[2026-06-08] POST /api/integrations only accepts ics + github in its ALLOWED_PROVIDERS set. OAuth providers like notion MUST be created via the OAuth callback route, never via POST — this is an intentional security boundary so callers can't fabricate IntegrationConnection rows that bypass token encryption.

[2026-06-08] AES-256-GCM crypto helper at src/lib/integration-crypto.ts is shared across all OAuth providers. Ciphertext format 'v1:<iv_b64>:<authtag_b64>:<ciphertext_b64>' is version-prefixed so the algorithm can rotate without a data migration. Master key in env var INTEGRATION_TOKEN_KEY — rotating the env key is destructive (all users must reconnect).

[2026-06-08] OAuth route convention: /api/integrations/<provider>/oauth/start and /api/integrations/<provider>/oauth/callback. State nonce stored in httpOnly Lax cookie named <provider>_oauth_state (10 min max-age), verified + deleted on callback. Page surface signals outcomes via ?<provider>=connected | ?<provider>=error%3D<slug> — the page's useEffect parses by checking flag.startsWith('error=').

[2026-06-08] UI flag NEXT_PUBLIC_<PROVIDER>_OAUTH_ENABLED gates whether the Connect card renders on /integrations. Inlined at build time — must restart npm run dev when toggling. Connect cards use <a className={buttonVariants(...)}> NOT <Button asChild> (base-ui doesn't support asChild).

[2026-06-08] Surface consolidated: standalone /(app)/integrations route deleted (now a 5-line server redirect to /dashboard?settings=integrations). All UI lives in src/components/integrations-section.tsx, rendered as a section inside PortalSettingsPanel's left-rail nav. The provider Connect cards still gate on NEXT_PUBLIC_<PROVIDER>_OAUTH_ENABLED.

[2026-06-08] URL-flag handling moved from per-page useEffect to a single effect in src/components/sidebar.tsx (AppHeader). Sidebar parses ?settings=<sectionId> and ?<provider>=<flag>, opens the dialog on the right tab via initialSection prop, fires toast + invalidates ['integrations'] query, then router.replace(pathname) to strip flags. New OAuth providers should NOT add their own page-side useEffect — extend sidebar's switch instead.

[2026-06-08] OAuth redirect contract updated: start + callback routes now redirect to /dashboard?settings=integrations&<provider>=<flag> for ALL outcomes (connected, error=<slug>, not_configured). Login redirects use ?next=/dashboard%3Fsettings%3Dintegrations. Workflow recipe docs/workflows/add-oauth-integration-provider.md updated to match.

[2026-06-08] Sprint 6A complete: Notion OAuth credentials wired (public connection 37ad872b-594c-81a2-b672-0037ad47e035). Round-trip verified end-to-end with workspace 'Sory Kaba 2nd Brain' (id 7adfe93c-f1f4-4660-b596-e407cdf7cacb). Token persisted as v1:<iv>:<authtag>:<ciphertext> (113 chars), confirmed NOT plaintext (no secret_/ntn_ prefix). config row stores {botId, tokenRef, workspaceId, workspaceName} — only tokenRef.accessToken is encrypted; metadata is plaintext by design.

[2026-06-08] Sprint 6B starts here: implement Notion sync handler. Current placeholder copy 'Page import — coming in next release' is rendered when a notion-row's sync button is pressed. The /api/integrations/[id]/sync route's notion branch is the next implementation surface.

[2026-06-08] Sprint 6B v1 complete (ADR-0019). Notion import on-ramp shipped: GET /api/integrations/notion/pages (paginated workspace search, 100-page cap, dedup against existing WorkLog externalId), POST /api/integrations/notion/import (sequential per-page, 25/req cap, transactional WorkLog + WorkLogImport, P2002 race-safe, error-redaction for tokens). Pure converter src/lib/worklog/import/notion-to-pm.ts handles 8 block types (paragraph, heading_1/2/3, bulleted/numbered_list_item, to_do, code, quote, callout, divider, toggle) with marks (bold/italic/strike/underline/code/link). Idempotency uses WorkLog.externalSource='notion' + externalId=pageId; the unique key @@unique([userId, externalSource, externalId]) makes re-import a no-op (skip-on-reimport, protects local edits). NO schema migration was needed — all columns existed. Folder 'Imported from Notion' is auto-created per user. Lossy: images/embeds/video/tables emit '[unsupported X block]' placeholders + counted in WorkLogImport.droppedBlocks. UI: <NotionImportDialog /> in src/components/integrations/notion-import-dialog.tsx (flat checkbox picker, dimmed already-imported badges, filter input, deep-link to Notion). Wired into IntegrationsSection 'Browse pages' button replacing the 6A placeholder. New dependency: @notionhq/client. ImportSourceType extended to include 'notion'. Tests: 25 unit tests on the pure converter, 127/127 import-suite green.
